scope: Independent UI critique only; no production-readiness claim.

dimensions.label: Hierarchy and visual coherence
five_requires: The current role and page task are evident in the first viewport; one primary action or information group leads.
Existing Obligon logo, green/navy roles, icon treatment, type scale, surfaces, and spacing remain coherent across shared shells and page content.
Desktop and phone renders have no competing decorative emphasis, collisions, accidental nested containers, or inconsistent state styling.
evidence: Current full-page desktop and phone screenshots
Measured color contrast for distinct text and control surfaces

dimensions.label: Responsive fit and readability
five_requires: Layouts fit 1440, 768, 390, and 320 CSS-pixel widths; 200% zoom preserves readable content and reachable actions.

No page-level horizontal overflow, clipped text, obscured footer action, or inappropriate fixed width; genuine tables retain all columns through an accessible scroll container or deliberate responsive treatment.
Long names, amounts, references, validation messages, and empty states wrap predictably; scrolling remains available after visible indicators are removed.
evidence: Viewport screenshots or recorded geometry at 1440/768/390/320
Pointer, touch, and keyboard scrolling checks including nested containers

dimensions.label: Interaction and accessibility
five_requires: Visible controls operate; keyboard focus is visible and ordered; labels, semantics, and touch targets support the actual task.
Dialogs, menus, search, tabs, and mobile navigation open, close, restore focus, and expose their status using established accessible patterns.
Normal text reaches 4.5:1 contrast, large text and non-text controls reach 3:1; reduced motion and appropriate announcements are verified.
evidence: Interaction receipt or test output for shared controls and route-specific actions
Screen-reader/accessible-tree verification where provided; omissions disclosed

dimensions.label: State completeness and honest feedback
five_requires: Every applicable initial/loading/ready/empty/no-results/error/retry/validation/submitting/success/disabled/session-expired or denied state is evidenced.
Errors preserve user input, identify the problem, provide a usable recovery route, and do not masquerade as empty/success; loading does not obscure stale or partial failures.
Money/auth actions distinguish pending, failed, and uncertain outcomes through existing product semantics, without redesign-driven behavior changes.
evidence: Per-state screenshots or deterministic test receipts tied to the current source
Explicit N/A reason for inapplicable states; no blanket assumption

dimensions.label: Route and task clarity
five_requires: Page heading, active navigation, role context, and action names agree; a user can identify the next task without guessing.
Links, selected search results, return paths, query-driven destinations, and aliases reach the intended canonical location with relevant context.
Existing kept features and restrictions remain reachable and understandable, including subscriptions in My Card, company approval, and partner/workshop distinctions.
evidence: Route/role walkthrough and navigation/search destination checks
Redirect and query-preservation receipts for aliases

level_anchors.0: Verified unusable or unavailable: the route or essential task cannot be used.
level_anchors.1: Verified serious obstruction: the task fails or the presentation conceals essential information.
level_anchors.2: Verified substantial defects: several material issues obstruct the task or create misleading feedback.
level_anchors.3: Usable within the reviewed scope, with a concrete quality, interaction, or coverage gap.
level_anchors.4: Polished and usable within evidenced scope; only minor concrete defects or limited unverified edge cases remain.
level_anchors.5: All dimension acceptance criteria are met by current relevant evidence; no unresolved finding in this dimension.

score_rules.not_applicable_requires: A specific written reason and evidence that the state/dimension truly does not apply.
score_rules.overall: Minimum of all applicable dimension scores only after all applicable dimensions are reviewed; otherwise null.
score_rules.target: Every canonical page must score 5 in every applicable dimension; aliases require navigation evidence but no invented visual screen.
score_rules.static_screenshot_limits: Static images cannot prove interaction, recovery, screen-reader behavior, or successful money/auth effects.
score_rules.regression: Relevant source changes invalidate affected prior evidence; latest changes require rescore or explicit unscored flag.
score_rules.plateau: After two rounds with no score changes, identify a structural change or report the plateau honestly.

required: scroll containers with visible scrollbar indicators suppressed and scrolling retained
shared_shell_checks.limits: Screenshots show shared shells and overflow instructions; root reports specific key/focus/scroll checks. Complete zoom,screen-reader,all-state and all-dialog evidence is unavailable.
